q: The medicine proved completely ___ against the headache. (USE)
We were all impressed by his ___ during the interview. (HONEST)
explain: Rzeczownik od honest: honesty (h jest nieme).

q: The match ended with a ___ victory for the home team. (DECIDE)
It is ___ to finish the project by tomorrow. (POSSIBLE)
explain: Przeciwieństwo z przedrostkiem im- przed p: impossible.

q: She spoke very ___ in front of the large audience. (CONFIDENCE)
The ___ of the festival took almost a year. (ORGANISE)
explain: Rzeczownik od organise: organisation (brytyjska) lub organization.

q: He was punished for his ___ in class. (BEHAVE)
The rainy weather made the journey extremely ___. (PLEASE)
explain: Przymiotnik z przeczeniem: pleasant → unpleasant (nie please → displease).

q: The company is looking for a ___ assistant. (RELY)
Their ___ lasted for more than fifty years. (FRIEND)
She was so ___ that she lost her keys twice a week. (CARE)
The scientists made an important ___ last year. (DISCOVER)
He has an ___ collection of old maps. (IMPRESS)
explain: Przymiotnik od impress: impressive; przed samogłoską stoi an.

q: A good ___ of foreign languages is useful in many jobs. (KNOW)
explain: Rzeczownik od know: knowledge (ze zmianą pisowni).

q: The results of the first tests were very ___. (ENCOURAGE)
The two countries signed an ++agreement++ on trade.
explain: Agreement = porozumienie, umowa; najbliższe znaczeniowo jest deal.

q: Her ++ambition++ is to become a pilot.
explain: Ambition = ambicja, cel; najbliższe jest aim.

q: The audience was ++furious++ about the delay.
We need to ++postpone++ the meeting until Monday.
explain: Postpone = odłożyć na później, czyli delay.

q: He is known for his ++generous++ character.
explain: Generous = hojny; najbliższe jest giving (skłonny dawać).

q: The ++huge++ rock blocked the road.
Scientists have ++discovered++ a new species of frog.
The teacher gave us a ++brief++ summary of the story.
The ++crowd++ cheered when the singer appeared on the stage.
explain: Crowd = tłum, czyli duża grupa ludzi.

q: He tried to ++conceal++ the truth from his parents.
The mayor promised to (zmniejszyć) the number of cars in the centre.
Her speech was so (wzruszająca) that many people cried.
explain: Przymiotnik opisujący to, co wzrusza: moving (moved opisuje osobę).

q: The film received excellent (recenzje).
explain: Review = recenzja; revision to powtórka lub korekta.

q: I'm sorry, but I can't (zgodzić się) with you.
explain: Agree with + osoba = zgadzać się z kimś.

q: (Bezrobocie) has fallen again this year.
She (przyznała się) that she had made a mistake.
The tickets were (wyprzedane) within an hour.
We (zdecydowaliśmy się) to change the date.
explain: Decide to + bezokolicznik: we decided to change.

q: He is very (utalentowany).
I look forward (do) hearing from you.
(Mimo że) he was tired, he finished the race.
explain: Although + zdanie; despite wymaga rzeczownika lub -ing.

q: She was (zazdrosna o) her sister's success.
explain: Be jealous of = być zazdrosnym o.

q: It is (wygodniej) to travel by train.
explain: Stopień wyższy długiego przymiotnika: more comfortable.

q: He apologised (za) being late.
(Dzięki) the new bridge, the journey is faster.
